buildCommand: bash -c 'set -e; echo "Installing Flutter..."; curl -L https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/linux/flutter_linux_3.32.5-stable.tar.xz -o flutter.tar.xz; tar xf flutter.tar.xz; export PATH="$PWD/flutter/bin:$PATH"; flutter config --no-analytics; flutter pub get; flutter build web --release --dart-define=SUPABASE_URL=$SUPABASE_URL --dart-define=SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY --dart-define=GEMINI_API_KEY=$GEMINI_API_KEY'
